checks: Read each immutable worker gzip and full JSONL ledger sequentially; hash compressed/raw bytes and match completion receipts.
Verify all worker identities, unique complete query sets, matching paired order, strict source/cache/budget/token metadata and the complete recorded non-timing row across all rounds.
Recompute all round, first-round, repeat-round and pooled latency p50/p95/means from saved individual timings; reproduce original10/10/5/5 gates without changing thresholds.
Check actual SDK MCP and native full-native payload equality for both comparable surfaces.
Independent agent recomputes28 resource comparisons and all4storage boundaries across16workers; retain every adverse result.

boundaries.exact_seeded_shuffle_verified_by: unchanged registered hosted auditor; this independent recomputation separately checks complete sets and per-round paired order, without claiming a second PRNG implementation
boundaries.reference_tokenization_verified_by: unchanged pinned reference-tokenizer measurement; independently recheck all saved counts/budget metadata and equality without repeating tokenizer or retrieval

method: Do not read running worker outputs. Root supplies immutable final result commit; publish exact input identity/size/hash receipt first.

Read worker and complete original JSONL ledger in fixed16worker order through base64; check every compressed/raw receipt hash, count and exact begin/finished sequence. Retain all failed predicates without rerunning source or evaluation.

Require four rounds, original ABBA engine/cohort/configuration inventory, unique complete per-cell query sets, paired query order, runtime identities, cache counts, original token budgets and both saved tokenizer count structures.

Compare every recorded non-timing row field except wall_ms and engine_source_sha256 across engines and all rounds. Keep all differences, not a sample; check native-payload hashes between actual SDK MCP and native for char4000/token1024.
Independently recompute per-worker/per-round/first-round/repeat-round/pooled latency and original numeric response/token summaries from original individual values.

Preserve original10/10/5/5 numeric gates and their1e-9 boundary tolerance. Resource28 and storage4 are separately audited by baseline_audit; do not auto-waive resource review or claim release acceptance.

numeric_policy.integers: Parse exact JSON integer tokens with existing BigInt parser; validate counters and budget integers strictly. Preserve original floating wall-ms binary64 values.
numeric_policy.percentiles: Sort ascending and use source formula ordered[lower]+(ordered[upper]-ordered[lower])*(location-lower), location=(n-1)*q for q0.5/0.95.
numeric_policy.mean: Independent exact signed integer superaccumulator in units2^-1074; round sum to nearest-even binary64, then divide by n, matching statistics.fmean's fsum/n contract.
numeric_policy.declared_numeric_comparison: abs(independent-declared)<=2e-12*max(1,abs(independent),abs(declared)); exact counts, strings, null, booleans and complete row structures remain exact. Retain maximum errors and all out-of-tolerance values.
numeric_policy.gate_decision: Use unchanged original numeric thresholds and1e-9 boundary tolerance on recomputed values; do not apply declaration-comparison tolerance to alter gate thresholds. Flag any differing claimed decision and retain near-boundary limits.

foundations.use: Only exact JSON integers, bounded UTF8/base64 and gzip byte verification; no SQL-specific adapter.

storage: Own validation branch only, all new files under benchmarks/reports/round5-formal-readonly-auditor/; never modify frozen evaluator, runtime or fresh manifest.
